answer: Call it random transcript audit. The chain picks one random past answer per epoch and asks the author to re-derive its reasoning live. A fable streak of two mismatches moves the identity to manual review and freezes its emission. The attacker pays: covering 8049 identities takes 236669 tokens, 40 operator hours and 14 days of exposure.
